selection: Generated by scripts/select-demo-borrower.ts, which runs the page engine (lib/position-sim runComparison) over every row of the full on-chain census of 10-11 Oct 2025 (membrane-datasets oct10-2025/coverage/census.json) with NO deployment and ranks by equityDeltaUsd, ties broken by the census gap (Aave closed minus Membrane closed). Eligible: a mainnet Aave V3 Core position (protocols.json is a read of that pool, so its risk parameters and the token addresses only apply there) whose whole t0 composition is ONE collateral leg priced by the measured path AND present in protocols.json aaveV3.reserves, and ONE debt leg priced or a $1 stable held flat; collateralUsd $50k-$3M (no whales); the first Aave liquidation at least 60 minutes into the path, so the hero is not a minute-0 artifact; the census says Membrane closes LESS than Aave on it; the census outcome and the live engine agree on outcome class when the live engine is run the census's way (fee 0, no deployment); run at the census's own line the live engine lands on the census row (Aave's first liquidation and the first sale within 2 minutes, the same sales, closed USD within 1%); and equityDeltaUsd > 0 with NO deployment. 6 rows cleared every gate and this one won on the ranked figure at $58,377. THE TOKEN AMOUNTS ARE REAL (fixed 2026-09-14): the collateral and debt amounts are the measured USD over the oracle prices those dollars were read at (pLiqColl / pLiqDebt, the census t0 AaveOracle prices), then repriced at minute 0. They used to be the measured USD over the MINUTE-0 price, which back-solved an amount that reproduced the liquidating LTV at midnight - a breached position planted 21 hours before the wallet breached. WHAT CHANGED (owner ruling 2026-09-14): the fixture used to ship an ASSUMED deployment - half the measured debt in a venue modelled at 60% recall / 55% fast - and rank on the equity delta that assumption produced. It is gone. The census has no venue anywhere in it, so a hero ranked on a venue was a hero about the assumption. The hero now equals its own census row exactly. Membrane is charged a ZERO liquidation fee (the live simulator's own default); Aave is charged its own measured weighted liquidationBonus.

noDeployment.reason: MEASURED ABSENCE, not a modelling choice. Aave liquidated this wallet and the borrowed dollars were gone; no venue balance is detectable behind it, and the Oct 10 census has no venue in it either. The fixture therefore ships venue null and the hero figure is the bare run, which is the same number its census row carries.

diagnosticWithOldAssumedDeployment.note: NOT SHIPPED. Retained only so the ruling that removed it can be checked.

selectionPool.definition: mainnet Aave V3 Core, one collateral and one debt leg, $50k–$3M of collateral at t0
